# opencie-pkcs11

> A cross-platform C++ library implementing the PKCS#11 interface for the Italian CIE (Carta d'Identità Elettronica / Electronic Identity Card). Exposes the private key and authentication certificate stored on the CIE chip so that standard-compliant applications — browsers, TLS stacks, signing tools — can use them without any card-vendor middleware.

- Version: 1.0.0
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later
- Language: C++20 / C
- Platforms: Linux (x86_64, aarch64), macOS (arm64), Windows (x86_64), Android (arm64-v8a, x86_64)
- Output: libopencie-pkcs11.so / .dll / .dylib

## Public API

The public C interface is declared in `include/opencie/cie_ext.h`.

### Enrolment
- `cie_enable(pan, pin, attempts, progress_cb, completed_cb)` — enrol a CIE card
- `cie_is_enabled(pan)` — check enrolment status (returns 1/0)
- `cie_disable(pan)` — remove enrolment

### PIN Management
- `cie_change_pin(current, new, attempts, progress_cb)` — change PIN
- `cie_unblock_pin(puk, new_pin, attempts, progress_cb)` — unblock with PUK

### Certificate
- `cie_get_certificate(pan, outDer, outLen)` — retrieve DER-encoded X.509 cert (caller must free)

### Signing & Verification
- `cie_sign(inPath, type, pin, pan, page, x, y, w, h, imageData, imageDataLen, outPath, progress_cb, sign_cb)` — sign PDF or produce P7M
- `cie_verify(inPath, proxyAddr, proxyPort, usrPass)` — verify signed document
- `cie_get_sign_count()` — number of signatures from last verify
- `cie_get_verify_info(index, verifyInfo_t*)` — signer details for n-th signature
- `cie_extract_p7m(inPath, outPath)` — unwrap .p7m envelope

### Reader Discovery
- `cie_reader_count()` — number of connected smart-card readers
- `cie_reader_watch(current_count)` — block until reader count changes
- `cie_reader_name(buf, buf_len)` — name of the first reader

### Low-level
- `make_digest_info(algid, digest, digestLen, out, outLen)` — build PKCS#1 DigestInfo for raw RSA flows

### Timestamp, Encrypt & Decrypt
- `cie_timestamp(inFilePath, tsaUrl, tsaUsername, tsaPassword, outTokenPath, progress_cb)` — RFC 3161 timestamp via TSA (SHA-256, no card needed)
- `cie_encrypt(pan, inFilePath, outFilePath, progress_cb)` — encrypt with card's RSA public key (RSA-OAEP / hybrid AES-256-GCM+RSA-OAEP, no card needed)
- `cie_decrypt(inFilePath, pin, pan, outFilePath, progress_cb)` — decrypt with card's RSA private key (card required)

## Key Source Paths

- `include/opencie/cie_ext.h` — public C API header
- `pkcs11/src/` — PKCS#11 module (slot, session, object, mechanism management)
- `shared/src/crypto/` — AES, DES3, RSA, SHA, MAC, Base64, MD5
- `shared/src/pcsc/` — APDU, PC/SC transport, card locking, Android NFC
- `shared/src/csp/` — ATR parsing, extended auth key, IAS protocol
- `sign-sdk/src/` — PDF signing, XAdES, CMS/PKCS#7, TSA client, ASN.1 codec
- `tests/` — Catch2 unit tests

## Build

```bash
# Linux (native)
meson setup builddir && meson compile -C builddir
# Output: builddir/libopencie-pkcs11.so

# Portable (container)
podman build -t libopencie-builder -f Containerfile .
podman run --rm -v $(pwd)/output:/output libopencie-builder x86_64
```

- Go: https://github.com/M0Rf30/opencie-pkcs11-go
